title: 'I make things move' — animation principles reel with handwritten annotations
summary: A 15 s motion-designer reel that teaches while it shows off: a bouncing blue ball with onion-skin trails and handwritten blue/red notes ('slow in, slow out', 'squash!', 'stretch'), the ball becomes the full stop of I MAKE THINGS MOVE., then STRETCH / SNAP on dark, a position/time graph proving 'linear = robotic' (struck through) vs 'ease in-out', a follow-through dot arc, an anticipation dial counting to 80%, and a 'MOTION DESIGNER / CLAUDE.' end card with 'open to new projects'. A timeline scrubber at the bottom labels each principle. Feels like a smart teacher's whiteboard.
fit_reason: The 'visual teacher' device (handwritten arrows and notes on a clean diagram, struck-through wrong answer, right answer in blue) matches Andrew's simplifier voice and can annotate SaaSSuite screens the same way.

palette.mood: light whiteboard grey with soft vignette, switching to near-black for punchy beats; one blue (correct/hero) and one red (wrong/warning)

typography.display: condensed heavy grotesk caps (Bebas Neue Pro / Anton / Oswald Bold look) for headlines; casual handwritten marker font (Caveat / Kalam look) for annotations in blue and red
typography.case: upper for display, lower for handwriting
typography.size_behaviour: huge centred headline words; small handwritten notes with curved arrows
typography.notes: The blue ball doubles as the full stop after MOVE and CLAUDE. Bottom timeline track with diamond keyframes labelled in handwriting (spacing, type, easing, anticipation, hello); timecode top-right.

text_animation: letters fall in from above on a stagger with vertical motion blur, overlapping and landing with slight squash (MOVE at 2.0 s)
word-by-word drop with random tilt ('MO TI ON DES' tumbling at 13.3 s) settling into a clean stack
handwritten notes write on stroke by stroke with a curved arrow
red strike-through draws across a wrong note, corrected note writes on in blue
single words stretch horizontally / snap in hard on dark (STRETCH, SNAP)
motion: bouncing ball with onion-skin ghost circles showing spacing
graph line morphs from straight to S-curve with a dot riding it
square sliding across with motion-blur frames showing linear vs eased spacing
anticipation dial with a counting % and ring of dots
transitions: hard cuts on beats between light and dark sections
ball carries across scenes as the continuity element
ui_treatment: none (diagram-style, could annotate a UI the same way)

sound.music: upbeat electronic/plucky bed, no voice, -11.7 LUFS
sound.sync: ball bounces and word drops on beats

signature_moves: handwritten blue/red notes with arrows on a clean diagram
wrong idea struck through in red, right idea written in blue
hero ball becomes the headline's full stop
keyframe timeline at the bottom labelling the current lesson

best_segments.what: Bouncing ball with onion-skin + handwritten 'slow in, slow out / squash! / stretch', then letters of I MAKE THINGS MOVE fall in and the ball lands as the full stop.
Graph: 'linear = robotic' in red gets struck through, curve eases into an S, 'ease in-out' writes on in blue.
Words tumble in and settle into MOTION DESIGNER / CLAUDE. with handwritten 'open to new projects' arrow.

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP: SplitText chars from y:-200 with stagger 0.045 and a blur filter on the way down; SVG paths with stroke-dashoffset for handwriting (or a handwriting font revealed by a mask); MotionPath for the ball; graph path morph (MorphSVG or interpolate d). Bottom timeline is static SVG with a moving playhead.
